name: US equity stress
summary: S&P 500 falls over 3% on 5 Nov as chip stocks slide; drawdown passes the 5% Watch line
state: The S&P 500 fell more than 3% on 5 Nov, its worst day since 2025, and the Nasdaq dropped about 5% as AI and chip stocks sold off, erasing the post-midterm rally (Yahoo Finance; BNN Bloomberg). The index is 5.3% below its 52-week high and the VIX rose to about 24.5, both inside the Watch band. October payrolls on 6 Nov are the next test.
for_you: Market falls feed through to pensions and investment funds with equity exposure; this describes conditions, not a reason to act.
rubric_hit: VIX 28.2 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 5.95% ≥ 5% Watch line

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Nasdaq plunges 5% as chip stocks sell off
BNN Bloomberg — AI stock wipeout sends S&P 500 down more than 3%

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
